[b]Optimization, crashes, fixes:[/b]
Improvements regarding the impact of trucks and foliage on performance. 
Introduction of AMD FSR, the tech which will boost framerate.

Distance measure for Navigation system got a fix.

notes.title: Heavy Duty Challenge Update | Nov 2023
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

The time has come to publish a big update we have been working on since release. It deals with some of the biggest issues you’ve reported and makes changes based on feedback we’ve received over the weeks.  

Here are the main points: 

[b]1. Optimization [/b]
The update brings performance optimizations - the game will run smoother and without stuttering. 

[b]2. Wheel Controllers & Game Pads [/b]
Force feedback on wheel controllers is here, finally, and we’d like to hear how the game plays for you with this change. 

We have also fixed issues with Thrustmaster and Fanatec gear shifter support; added the possibility to navigate menus with the wheel; tweaked support for some gamepads (including PS4 pad) for better experience. 

[b]3. New Level & Progress [/b]
The game has a new level called Mountain Village, with three new sections. You will also notice some changes in game progress, order of levels, rewards, prices, etc. - especially if you start your game career from scratch. 

[b]4. Visual Update [/b]
We have enhanced the look of the game, and we think the changes not only add to the overall quality but give HDC a new vibe. 

[b]5. Bugfixes & Tweaks [/b]
We have done a bunch of fixes to the game plus tweaked some mechanics for better quality of life. A few known issues we’re still working on include an achievement bug some of you reported, which we’ll be including in an upcoming fix. 


Thanks to everyone who played the game, gave us feedback, left comments and ideas. Let us know what you think about the update and if you like it, we’ll be grateful for good reviews. Stay tuned for more – we are working on an exciting expansion. 

Take care!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/767a487ce7b4d8d114ed6c94512b781781f75a43.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Heavy Duty Challenge | Patch 1.1

we've released a "quality of life" patch to deal with some of the issues you've reported, here's the list of changes:

1. Display mode switch
In the Graphics settings, you can now select between fullscreen, windowed, fullscreen windowed and multi-monitor mode.

2. Camera adjustment
In Pause Menu, you can adjust the position of 3rd person camera and all three cabin views, too.
As before, sensitivity and axes inversion is available in controller settings.

3. Xbox 360 controller & Dead Zone setting
We've added a dead zone setting to all controllers - this will help with the issues some xbox 360 gamepad users have reported.

4. Controller configuration & icons
We fixed reported issues with controller configuration.
We have also cleaned up the bug with wrong device icon in the controller settings. 

5. Ultra graphics settings
We have added an Ultra preset to the graphics settings.

As you can see, we've begun with camera issues, settings issues and gamepad support. Performance fixes and wheel controller updates will be included in upcoming patches. 

Thanks for playing HDC:)
Have a great weekend!
Lukasz from Nano Games

notes.title: Heavy Duty Challenge | Update before Open Playtest
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are soon beginning the Open Playtest on Steam (July 8th at 10 am CEST) and everyone's invited! 

But first, we'd like to thank all the people who have already played the closed demo, sent us comments, and recorded or streamed the footage (or are planning to do so). You and your viewers have provided us with a ton of useful ideas and feedback.  

Since we still had a little time before tomorrow, we managed to smooth out a couple of issues. Here are some notes: 


[b]1. Gamepads and wheel controllers [/b]

There were some issues reported, especially with newer controllers (like PS5 DualSense or Logitech G923). The bugs have been fixed. 

 
[b]2. Optimization [/b]

We have introduced some fixes regarding display resolution, which should help with framerate issues encountered on some specs. Optimization is something we will of course keep working on until the September release (and beyond). 


[b]3. Settings [/b]

We've disabled the settings on purpose, as we are still working on some features. We hope you will understand, even though it’s cool to set all options to your favorite. 


[b]4. Sound volume control [/b]

We got feedback that the game seemed a little loud, which you can’t change in-game due to blocked settings. For now, please use the Windows sound mixer. 


[b]5. Languages [/b]

As of today, we feature 16 languages. We are aware not all translations are perfect yet but decided to enable them all in the open playtest just the same. We'll update with corrections soon, but after the playtest. 

  

We're looking forward to more feedback.  

Don't forget about the Open Playtest on Steam (July 8th at 10am CEST - July 10th at 10am) - play, get high scores and win prizes! 

Visit Heavy Duty Challenge server on Discord: https://discord.gg/5g2PQK9K3x 

Join the Q&A on r/TruckSim on Discord on Sunday, July 9th at 6pm CEST: https://discord.gg/trucksim 

  

We hope you’ll enjoy the game :) 

Until next time, 
Nano Games Team

notes.title: Heavy Duty Challenge Devlog #17: the HDC development update
notes.notes:
Hi All and welcome to another Heavy Duty Challenge devlog. How have you been? Because we have been busy! Here’s the HDC development update: 

[b]1. New Levels – plural [/b]

Do you remember last time, when we promised a new level? Well, we decided to go a little further and build more of those. We are still using the environment of the Polish Jura region, but we have made two maps to play: 

- “Jurassic Highland, Poland” is a truck trial level which will allow you to beat hardcore challenges in a sports competition. We use this terrain for the (separate) tutorial levels, too 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/fc25cb27e36b61e125199c6c9b4d4791fa8a46f8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/54a774dd6c5c111851b576e99b895cc651d9ca0d.png[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games[/url][i], Jurassic level with a view of the castle. Work In Progress.[/i][/i]


- “Disenchanted Forest” is an open level for cross-country play and exploration 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/e90b99026c0d36cbd1bc19b26579ef3a80398ba2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/8c62f69481836b11cca8609fab91d238bda5e5e9.png[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games[/url][i], Five Gates. Work In Progress.[/i][/i]

[b]2. Five Gates mode [/b]

Why build an “open world” level in an obstacle-course-based truck trial game? To introduce a new game mode, of course, which we called Five Gates. It is a scavenger hunt of sorts – but in a truck! You go on a cross-country drive into a forest and search for gates to pass, for which you get points. But the forest hides many secrets and there is plenty of exciting, beautiful and funny locations to visit for bonus score.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/4b318d058b8e89d355102ba9eab594279d2a4f1a.gif[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games[/url]. Work In Progress.[/i]
 

[b]3. Life [/b]

Looking at the screenshots from the new levels, you will surely see a difference to previous iterations of the game – we’ve finally added foliage, bushes, grass and trees. Hopefully, you’re just as excited about this as we are – the feature was challenging to implement and keep the game optimized. But the team did great!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/9c1ed8539c58bff6462a073adc6096d82b69aed8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/c41a7fcae7797a5a8a78772dab438b25f851b839.gif[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games[/url]. Work In Progress.[/i]
 

[b]4. Dirt [/b]

So far, all trucks looked awesome but very, very clean. Now they will get dirty as you play, to capture how real truck trials always end: with everything and everyone happy, but covered in dirt from top to bottom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/3e97a553c18aba427e8dcb8da671b5be0e774c93.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/015dfc41519cf71d241c0e1aff5589f5822d62dc.png[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games[/url]. Before and after. Work In Progress.[/i]
 

[b]5. Localization [/b]

The game will be available in the following languages: Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Czech, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese & Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish. 


[b]6. Leaderboards [/b]

Getting leaderboards to work got us pretty competitive at Nano Games, and we’ll keep trying to beat each other in the trials until you, the Players, come along and put us to shame with your scores.  


[b]7. Platforms [/b]

As you remember from the last devlog, the game will be available on PC Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. Porting is going well, thanks for asking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/0f2b9e51cdb573f587952aec27d541f8c760651b.gif[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games[/url]. In the office[/i][i];)[/i]
 

On top of all that, we’re bug-fixing, optimizing, and testing, to make the game fun and high-quality. 

We hope you enjoyed this devlog, stay tuned for more. Add the game to your wishlist, and leave a comment or a question below. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/r6WWD3WPNw]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1165530/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], or find us on social media for more HDC news. 

Best, 
Nano Games Team

notes.title: Heavy Duty Challenge Devlog #16: the first devlog of 2023
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Welcome to the first Heavy Duty Challenge devlog of 2023. 

We’ve been working hard this year and thought you may want to know what our priorities have been recently. 

1. [b]New level[/b] 

We are adding another environment to the game, we’ve called it Jurassic Highland. It is based on a region in Poland (where some of our Team Members come from) and features a medieval castle’s ruins (Tenczyn), as well as amazing rocks dating back to – you guessed it – the Jurassic geologic period.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/3c94a1fa00210130c8d92f8d8f8024cdff79557c.png[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games.[/url][/i] [i]Tenczyn castle in the game engine's editor. Work In Progress.[/i]


2. [b]New trucks [/b]

Three new trucks are coming to the game, each in a different category. A two-axle IFA, a three-axle ZIL and a four-axle Mercedes-Benz, from Europa Truck Trials teams called Zwickau, Zebra ZIL and BF71. We will have 12 trucks available to play when we release the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/6eb8864ce87bf565bcaab44adf837a4ff966848e.png[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games.[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/a5d14d695a7bae248eaf2338ac4c99084e7c1794.png[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games.[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/c7283c912f381176f163f1ba806f35287f310138.png[/img]
[i]Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games.[/url][/i]

3. [b]Tutorial [/b]

Not a trivial task, mind you. We’re working on tutorial levels to teach newcomers how to operate basic and advanced off-road mechanics of the trucks in the game. 

4. [b]Rewards, leaderboards[/b] 

Still at it. Winning championships and completing truck trial events in the game will get you in-game money, XP and other rewards (trophies and such). High scores will also put you on online leaderboards, so you get bragging rights and internet fame. 

5. A[b]chievements[/b] 

For those of you who like difficult challenges and are most dedicated to your games, we’re adding achievements. You can’t have a game without them. 

6. [b]SFX & music[/b] 

Those players that have been with us longer than others, remember sound used to be an issue. If you listen to the game now, you will hear the sweet sound of real-life trucks and environment sound we’ve been all waiting for. We’re also adding awesome music to the game menus, loading screens, etc. 

7. [b]UI updates[/b] 

We’re getting close to adding all necessary menu screens and popups to the game. We love the style and visual identity of the game, and we hope you’ll like it too. 

8. [b]Visual quality upgrades and VFX[/b] 

A big and complex task, but we’re confident the changes we make now will bring smiles to your faces. We’ll show you more next time, we promise! 

9. [b]Porting[/b]  

The game’s coming not only to PC (Steam), but also PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. We’re hard at work on the console ports and they’re going to be awesome. 

10. [b]Optimization and bug fixes[/b] 

Finally, we’re making the game work well and smoothly. 

And that will be all info for now. Thanks for your time, stick around for more news on Heavy Duty Challenge. Don’t forget to join [url=https://discord.gg/AU7kFURwV7]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1165530/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]. Find us on social media, add the game to your wishlist, and leave a comment or question below.

Take care, 
Nano Games Team

notes.title: Heavy Duty Challenge Devlog #15: New Features and Content
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! Welcome to HDC Devlog #15.

In the past months, we’ve been working hard at Nano Games to bring new features and content to Heavy Duty Challenge and push the development of the game closer to next year’s release. It’s time to share some info about the work.

If you have any feedback, suggestions, or simply don't want to miss out on HDC news, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/AU7kFURwV7]Discord[/url] or follow the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1165530/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url].

So what has changed in Heavy Duty Challenge?
- [b]New level.[/b] Do you remember our post about the trip to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1165530/view/6231310141685769155]Iceland[/url]? All the scans, photos and videos we took back then were used to build a brand-new level, Dimmuborgir, the Dark Castles. Completely new terrain, a distinct visual style, even more challenging obstacles. We hope you’ll enjoy it all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/ac66d158374ad3f3b0807d54581c9193613462db.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/1378d321c89068bb0b29db240aee662870cdf712.jpg[/img]
[i]Marek - our Environment Artist and Łukasz - our Lead Designer at work;) 
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/a61cfa574765f66f31a4ea32535512e262d24db2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/973c83665b50111b6a19c632229168b975df7e8a.png[/img]
[i]Dimmuborgir[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/4373b3d51585f4cfeb351ff164c3323448d1991d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/0bf3ecd60b6de75fd03cd39c68b6c3b335207204.png[/img]
[i]Dimmuborgir[/i]


- [b]Quality enhancements.[/b] Of course, we’ve enhanced the looks of our French championship locations and the sound of trucks after a visit to Europa Truck Trials in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1165530/view/6231310141685769155]Montalieu-Vercieu[/url], another trip we talked about in a previous blog post.

- [b]VFX.[/b] It was time to add some visual effects. We hope the gif gives you an idea – the particle system is fully operational, and now we’re just introducing more VFX. It all adds to our fun with the game, so hopefully, you’ll enjoy it, too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/934ec8ab3a7d449f8ff34088a390b7a165f0b5af.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/d41ccae111d55881b3aa70655e9f2d4bd656d4f1.gif[/img]

- [b]The damage system.[/b] Not only will the “hit points” of the truck change when you ram into obstacles or crash down a cliff. Now, it all affects the truck’s performance. Drive a damaged truck, and your engine will stall, your gears won’t work, suspension will sag too much, and wheels may start to slip.

- [b]Upgrades.[/b] You can now upgrade your truck to match your play style. You can tweak engine power, suspension stiffness, steering angle, and more.

- [b]Reinforcements.[/b] Do you enjoy reckless driving, but it causes massive damage to your truck? Don’t worry, you can now reinforce the vehicle and protect vital systems.

- [b]Tire air pressure.[/b] The behaviour of the truck on different terrain changes depending on the amount of pressure in the tires. So, we now allow players to change that pressure.

- [b]Save game.[/b] Your best scores, truck damage, level progress, and many more details are finally saved safely by the game.

- [b]UI.[/b] All the above system changes and modifications required upgrades in the user interface. It has better UX, looks and performance.

- [b]Bug fixes and optimization.[/b] Always.

Thanks for joining us for this update on Heavy Duty Challenge development. We’ll be posting more when we have a bunch of new features to talk about. Don’t forget to join [url=https://discord.gg/AU7kFURwV7]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1165530/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] and say hello.

All the best,
Nano Games

notes.title: Heavy Duty Challenge Devlog #14: Iceland and France!
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Drivers! 

We are excited to share with you what we have been up to lately to ensure that Heavy Duty Challenge is as authentic as possible and has the best locations. To do this, we took a trip to Iceland for research and scanning, and another trip to France to meet with truck trial drivers! 
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Iceland [/h2]
We made a trip to Iceland with the goal of creating scans of the rocks and terrain there as research for an upcoming level set in Iceland. Our environmental artist Marek Barski and Lead Game Designer Łukasz Pleśniarowicz took these scans. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/f26078fc5094f2e6a8c23e6e1b28d0e653cc9204.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/c56d5af7e8d8311af6d7c2bb53771b31b96156bd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/248c54cfddacb181d04164b164f87a7303bb1187.jpg[/img]
[i]Marek using a drone to create the scans[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/c1ab55cae3fd7e50539a7ec84eccd03a6ef0d13e.jpg[/img]
[i]Łukasz on site, getting ideas and researching for the upcoming level.[/i]

The Nature in Iceland was absolutely breathtaking; it's hard to find anywhere else in the world that can compete with the landscapes we saw here. Łukasz even said it is his current favorite place in the world, which is why we will have it playable in the game!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Montalieu-Vercieu, France[/h2]
We also made a trip to France with the goal of more environmental scans, truck research, sound recordings, showcasing the game, and meeting the drivers and fans! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/e5bd23a140bbd45262e4d7498ceb5cf2fd7d9d56.jpg[/img]
[i]Łukasz Basiński (artist) and Marek Barski (enviro artist)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/e0687660c789ac3ea3afe85a0db4731c6fe1e442.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/629029f6251831665acf6f63c2d22552485c02a9.jpg[/img]
[i]Bartek (sound engineer) recording audio of trucks for in-game use [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/afa57005009b149625a65d20f0b7b136ac1a70f1.jpg[/img]
[i]Driver Marcel Schoch Hardox and his son trying out Heavy Duty Challenge[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/cf4f15b73e762d5d136f929b67ee809a17f5b35a.jpg[/img]
[i]The Nano Games Team in Montaileu![/i]

The trip to France was a fantastic opportunity to experience being part of the off-road community and watching people play Heavy Duty Challenge. However, it is also crucial that we take time to watch the real-life sport to make sure HDC is as accurate as possible. 
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

Thank you for joining us as we talk about our recent expeditions and joining us on the Heavy Duty Challenge journey! 

Remember to join our [url=https://discord.gg/AU7kFURwV7]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1165530/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] if you have any ideas, suggestions, or want to say hello!

See you next time,
Nano Games

notes.title: Devlog #13
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/844a2a3dba9f08f0be2eef797d7af8feb49e0686.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Welcome to our 13th Devlog.

We have been super busy here at Nano Games, working on many new things for you to enjoy, including new features, content, more polished gameplay, and an overall better experience.

Please join our Discord or the Steam Forums if you have any feedback, suggestions or don't want to miss out on our critical announcements.

Without further ado, let's get started:

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]More Content[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] We want to create an experience that resembles real life as much as possible. Therefore, we have been working extra hard to bring [b]FOURTEEN new obstacle courses[/b] for you to bring your inner truck-driving skills out! These will include two championships and four events based on official Europa Truck Trial locations.

[*] Do you have what it takes to conquer these new challenges?

[*] Many trucks compete in the Europa Truck Trials; we are delighted to share that three new truck models, featuring Unimog, Steyr, and Mercedes-Benz, will be joining the existing Unimog and MAN trucks in the garage.

[*] Prepare your gears! Championship, event, and truck selection menus are now available for a personalized experience. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/11ee79925d12a7e5bd62fac29030142aee7cca1b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Another thing we wanted to focus on for this update was SFX. The ones we had before did not match authentic truck engine sounds and were long due for an update. That's why we took a trip to the truck trials in Gröningen in Saxony-Anhalt, Germany, exclusively to record the engine sounds for this update!
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Gameplay Refinements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] We took our previous scoring system directly from the real-life championship rules, where you lose points for errors made. After many hours of playtesting and trying to make this experience as fun as possible, we have decided to update the scoring system. You will now be able to earn points! Changing the scoring system was a hard decision as we wanted to keep the experience as close to real life as possible, but we are confident that doing this will bring a much better experience to our players.

[*] Enhanced truck physics and parameters to be closer to what you would see in real-life events and competitions.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FHQUFSJ.gif[/img]
[list]

[*] Player career menus will bring a whole new level of customization to your experience! For example, you will now be able to select which championships or events to play. We have also included an option to choose, upgrade, and purchase new trucks. And to top it off, we have also included a way of viewing your trophies and leaderboards!

[*] Revamped HUD to make everything look better and much more appealing.

[*] Enhanced truck physics and parameters to be closer to what you would see in real-life events and competitions.

[*] Professional Europe Truck Trail drivers need to beat several obstacles during their events; since we want you to have the same experience, we have added [b]new interactive obstacles[/b], including various ramps and walls. 

[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/3MEEEgX.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Squashed Bugs
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for joining us on this devlog. We are very excited to keep bringing you more amazing content with each update, and we are very thankful to you for tagging along on this journey. 

Remember to join our [url=https://discord.gg/AU7kFURwV7]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1165530/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] if you have any ideas, suggestions, or want to say hello!

See you next time,
Nano Games

notes.title: #12 HDC DevLog - the differential lock
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

I hope you are well. This week I’d like to write a few words about one of the key mechanics in the game, the differential lock. Our prototype interface in the demo didn’t explain much, though I hope it helped to learn which buttons to push, at least. 

[i]Heavy Duty Challenge demo screenshot: diff lock information in the bottom right, plus a pop-up in the middle [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/df0954cbe93bac4897b9eea25ddf3a3736e2e8aa.png[/img]
Source: [url=https://nano-games.com/]Nano Games[/url] 

In general, the differential is a mechanism that allows the wheels to spin with different speeds. When you drive, it makes it easier and safer to take tight turns, for example.  

So why would you want to lock the differential?  

The mechanism affects the distribution of power to the wheels. When you lose traction on one wheel (e.g. it stops touching the ground, or touches a slippery surface), there may not be enough torque on the other wheel to keep the truck going forward. Especially in difficult terrain or when you’re driving up a hill. 

 In the game, like in real trucks, you’ll be able to lock the differentials and this way – to put it simply - you’ll have some control over which wheels and axles get a portion of the power. 

These are possible locks in a 3-axle truck, like the MAN on the screen above. 

[i]Inter-axle lock gets power transmitted equally to both rear axles [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/9367ac25e6c6bd02dd0e32315660d9e43ea773c7.png[/img]

[i]Central diff lock between the front and back – power is sent to all axles [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/b1c7b0cc3d4796f98cb174668ca2f84808aeb060.png[/img]

[i]Inter-wheel lock on the 2nd and 3rd axle – the four wheels in the back spin with the same speed [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/14a42728e98f9726450b0ead2b8d340ba4bbd351.png[/img]

[i]Inter-wheel lock on the front axle – all diff locks are on, equal distribution of power to the wheels [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/b8491a0b8b971d62b5d4a48f821a4a2e052b83e7.png[/img]


So why would you ever have the diff lock off? It puts strain on the axles, makes the tires wear out quicker and taking those tight turns will be more difficult. 

I bet some of you know even more about the physics and mechanics of the differential or have some thoughts on how it should work in the game – leave a comment or jump to our [url=discord.gg/HuwHrYbqjH]Discord[/url] to share!  

Best, 

Łukasz Pleśniarowicz, Lead Designer

But there’s also one easy-to-spot difference: the number of axles.  

In Europa Truck Trial, the championship that inspired our game, trucks are divided into categories, within which teams compete. Three of those categories will be featured in Heavy Duty Challenge base game: Categories II, III and IV, which means teams driving 2-axle, 3-axle, or 4-axle trucks.

notes.title: #10 HDC DevLog - Big thanks!
notes.notes:
Hello, 

Big thanks from Nano Games team to everyone who played Heavy Duty Challenge during our January playtest and February Steam Game Festival. Your support means a lot to us!  

We decided to sum up the feedback we’ve received, and answer some of the frequently asked questions. These are just the issues that have been discussed the most - feel free to post any other that come to mind here, on the forum, or on [url=https://discord.gg/HuwHrYbqjH]Discord[/url].  

[b]Will there be better sounds? [/b]

Let’s get this one out of the way. Yes, we’ll have better sounds. The sounds we used in January are out forever; the festival sounds were better, but temporary. This is a key feature, and we won’t neglect it, promise. 

[b]Will there be proper controller support? [/b]

After the first demo, it seemed like most people wanted the wheel controllers, so we made some (not final) updates to them. After the second, we’re sure the gamepad is just as important. We knew that all along. On release, we’ll fully support different types of controllers.  

[b]Can you make the rules like in Europa Truck Trial? [/b]

Generally, yes, we’ll make them as close as possible. We were happy to see how many fans (and teams!) of real-life truck trials are with us. You know the championships very well and were able to help us with getting the rules of the sport right. So next time you play, the errors you’ve found will be corrected. Hopefully, they never spoiled your fun. 

[b]Will there be bigger levels? [/b]

Yes. On release, levels will be open environments that you can drive around freely. Some parts of them will be sections – obstacle courses – which you enter to get points in the championship. This is also actually inspired by Europa Truck Trial. The demo was only one such section. 

[b]What other features are you working on? [/b]

We’re constantly tweaking the trucks, so they drive realistically, and look and feel right. We are working on a damage system – the trucks will break down if you are not careful. There will be a campaign mode we call Career and leaderboards to compare your scores with other players. And we’re adding more trucks and levels. 

[b]When will the game be out? [/b]

The Early Access release will be this year, but we first want to create something bigger, more polished and more exciting than just a demo. 

[b]What’s up with the bugs?[/b] 

We’re working on them all the time. 

 

If any more ideas come to your mind, feel free to comment. 

Thank you again for playing Heavy Duty Challenge - stay tuned for more! 


Best, 

Łukasz Pleśniarowicz, Lead Designer

notes.notes:
Hi Everybody!
How are you? Are you ready to take a closer look at Truck Trials? Today, I want to present you with the rules by which you’ll play Heavy Duty Challenge. For those of you who are familiar with rules of Europa Truck Trials it will be reassuring that we use them heavily and for people new to the sport, it is a perfect occasion to learn about its basics.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zDlt3hqMXAo

Some say that rules exist only to be broken and in Heavy Duty Challenge one of the rules is to not break a gate pole, so if you break it, you break a rule too! But to be honest, in this game you want to avoid breaking rules. In the real-life trials drivers try to avoid any mistakes, as they will give the team penalty points and the more you have, the lower is your position. It is the same in HDC. During the attempt on the section, if you touch or break a pole, change direction of driving, or stop for more than 15 seconds, the game will give you penalty points. You can also be disqualified for changing direction more than six times between two gates, so plan your route carefully.

If you reach the finish gate you are not safe yet. Any missed gates will cost you 100 points and probably push you down in the classification. And classification matters. After the whole event contestants will be sorted from the lowest number of penalty points to the highest and based on these standings the Championship points will be awarded, starting from 25 for the first place and going down with each next place. The last place awarded with only 1 CP is the 11th. 

I hope that you will soon have a chance to try how the rules work for you and become a champion of Heavy Duty Challenge! For now, add the game to the Wishlist and leave a comment here - which of the teams is your favorite?

notes.title: #2 Heavy Duty Challenge DevLog
notes.notes:
Welcome back!

Today I want to introduce you to one of the core features of the Heavy Duty Challenge - precisely depicted truck interiors. We understand that for every simulation game one of the main objectives is to maintain immersion, in our case to keep players in a fantasy of acting as a driver of a sports truck, and this requires recreating every nitty-gritty detail we can get. Therefore, we’re putting a lot of emphasis on interiors as that’s what the driver sees most of the time. Of course, there is no correct way of playing, so if you prefer exterior view, you're more than welcome, as we also created a detailed trucks’ chassis. But let’s get back inside! What can you expect?

Let’s start with an assumption - while playing from the interior, I don’t want any artificial HUD displaying, I want a pure experience. That creates a challenge of giving the player feedback about the truck’s state. Fortunately, as we’re recreating a real life machine, car designers already solved this issue. They add a ton of different control lights and switches inside. So we took them and made good use of them, giving players a chance to get all necessary information with just a glimpse. It goes without saying that there are also speed and rpm meters, as well as an animated steering wheel. Driving using only these indications might be challenging at first, but we believe it gives the best immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/77a8212124db14261f703d672e7a69c2a9dfd6e1.gif[/img]
[i]Lights go on and off indicating which truck’s systems are active.[/i]

Driving from the cabin view is cool, but it creates another difficulty. Unlike in other car driving games, what you see through a windshield is not enough in HDC. To precisely maneuver between obstacles, you need to see around the car. We have three methods that solve this for you to choose from. The first one is mirrors. They give you some additional information on what is behind you, just near the wheel and even directly in front of you. But they might be hard to read, so we introduce a set of fixed cameras near the front wheels and at the top of the cabin, basically simulating mirror views. That breaks immersion you say? True that, so here is the third method: if you drove a real truck, you could just look out the windows, right? So you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566763/a3bf0ee1cc811cf52add5692104f4b0608e0d74e.gif[/img]
[i]Being inside doesn’t mean you can’t look outside[/i]


As you can see, we’re taking interiors seriously and we think it helps us to give you the best off-road, truck driving experience. Stay tuned for next week's Team of the Month presentation and add Heavy Duty Challenge to your Wishlist if you haven’t already!
